test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In each of the following questions, a statement is given followed by 2 conclusions. Read the statements carefully and answer the

following questions:

Statement: Mr. X is one of the probable candidates short-listed for the post of Director of R.L.M. Institute.

325130

Conclusions:

I. Mr. X will be selected as Director of R.L.M. Institute.

II. Mr. X will not be selected as Director of R.L.M. Institute.
solution:
Given,

Statement:

Mr. X is one of the probable candidates short-listed for the post of Director of R.L.M. Institute.

Conclusions:

I. Mr. X will be selected as Director of R.L.M. Institute - **False** (Because, being a probable shortlisted candidate does not guarantee final selection).

II. Mr. X will not be selected as Director of R.L.M. Institute - **False** (Because, the statement does not provide any information that he will be rejected; he still has a chance of being selected).

So, either I or II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
